function.name: websearch
function.description: Search the web for current, factual, or verifiable information. Use this proactively whenever a question touches on facts that could have changed, specific data, current events, or anything you're not fully certain of — prefer searching over answering from memory.

query.description: The search query to run. Rewrite the user's question into an optimized search-engine query: strip conversational language, keep it concise, and use keywords a search engine would match well rather than a full sentence.

search_depth.description: Only use 'advanced' after first trying 'basic' with a refined or alternative query. Escalate to 'advanced' only if you've already searched with your best query at basic depth and still haven't found a sufficient answer — advanced returns more thorough, higher-relevance content per source at higher latency and cost.

freshness.description: Only set this if the user's request specifically implies a time constraint (e.g. 'latest,' 'this year,' 'recent news'). Leave unset for general or timeless questions.
